services.consultingDescription: Sapiens-IA supports you at every stage of your AI transformation: identifying the right use cases, developing custom solutions, durably embedding new practices across the organization, and confidently managing your AI tools and licenses. Our promise: simplicity, with relevant, measurable solutions rather than heavy, uncertain IT projects.
services.dataTitle: Data Consulting — Data, the Foundation of Your AI Transformation
services.dataDescription: Before AI, there is data. Sapiens-IA helps organizations structure, govern and unlock the value of their data assets to build a solid foundation for their AI projects. This offering complements our AI Consulting offer: where AI Consulting identifies and deploys AI use cases, Data Consulting secures and prepares the data that feeds those use cases.
